g.text: Works inside the tools you already run.
Each agent works where its job already lives. They all talk on one bus.
Logos show where each agent works. Live today: the 60 public sources and MCP. TMS and mail are read from exports and files; native links come next.

Model chips: the open-weight model each agent is built to run, hosted in the EU. Code-only agents compute exact answers (prices, records) and run no model. The prototype calls a US-hosted provider today.
Automates the desk. Acts before the route breaks.
